name: Pine Mountain-Cloverdale Peak
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: A small mountain AVA around Pine Mountain, about five miles north-northeast of Cloverdale, straddling the Mendocino and Sonoma county line. Its vineyards sit above 1,600 feet, higher than the fog that fills the valleys below.
